Title: PostgreSQL 11 is now generally available in Azure Database for PostgreSQL

Body.Content:
PostgreSQL 11, the latest major version of PostgreSQL, is generally available in Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Major enhancements in PostgreSQL 11 include a variety of improvements associated with partitioning, parallelism, stored procedures, Windows function support, and covering indexes, as well as several other performance enhancements. See the PostgreSQL 11 release notes for additional information about the newest functionality and how this version differs from PostgreSQL 10.

Learn more
